results.snippet:
The European Union and the United States plan to revive talks about China after a two-year hiatus, according to multiple people familiar with the planning.

The dialogue had stalled since Donald Trump’s return to the White House, but after being approached by Washington, talks are expected in the first week of December, despite the deterioration in transatlantic relations in the meantime. [...] Ad
